ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and send the driver's arrival-button use to Ryde account review for abuse of the "I'm Here"/cancellation flow + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat (F8–F10), the rider's complaint and the driver's statement (F12) contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the dispute type is no_show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

NS-0: cancelled_by = driver and the driver claims rider no-show (F12), so NS-1/NS-2 govern. Evidence: GPS and timeline are complete and cover the whole window (F1–F5), so evidence_status = sufficient.

NS-1 (i)–(iii) all fail:
(i) The tap did occur, but not at the pickup point — driver tapped "I'm Here" at 08:47:20 while 351 m from the pickup point [F5].
(ii) NS-1(ii) requires the driver within 200 m of the pickup at the moment of the tap. 351 m > 200 m [F5]; the driver's closest approach over the whole attempt was 319 m and he never entered 200 m [F1].
(iii) He stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap [F5]; his 4 minutes stationary (08:47:00–08:51:00) was spent 350 m away at (1.4069, 103.8988) [F2], not at the pickup point. The platform never recorded arrival at all (driver_arrived_at null) [F4].

Because (i)/(ii)/(iii) are not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider, refund_full, $6.61 [F3][F6]. The driver's written claim that he "waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" [F12] and his chat "Reached already" [F8] are contradicted by the system records (GPS/timeline override statements) and by the rider's contemporaneous "no car here" [F9].

Additionally, since the driver tapped "I'm Here" while GPS placed him outside the pickup radius (351 m > 200 m) [F5], NS-2's second limb applies and the case is flagged for Ryde account review (abuse of the cancellation/waiting-fee button). NS-7 requires the refund to issue as a Ryde voucher. No surge applied [F7]; no traffic cause is in play [F13][F14] and weather was fair [F15].

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited >3 minutes at the pickup is contradicted by GPS/timeline: tap at 08:47:20 was 351 m from pickup [F5], he never came within 200 m [F1], and he remained 350 m away [F2]. System records override statements. It is a claim of no-show, not proof of it.

Chat 'Reached already' is contradicted by F1/F5; a message asserting arrival does not establish the NS-1(ii) location requirement, and consent/claim rules (G11) treat unsupported assertions as claims only.
